content:
Jordan (PM): Quick review request 1: working on a compact pool selector that surfaces min/max, burst toggle, and an SLO slider. Need copy + a11y + infra sanity check before the 4pm design crit. Screenshot in figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-pool
Sara (Designer): Pitched layout: left column pool card, center min/max input, right side SLO slider + small 'expected throughput' line. Trying to keep density low for mobile. Thoughts?
Mike (SRE): Layout sounds fine. Two infra asks: 1) mark burst as 'best-effort' and make it opt-in. 2) show estimated token/sec/QPS ranges, not single number, to set expectations.
Leah (A11y): Keyboard: min/max stepper needs proper labels and +/- button aria labels. SLO slider must expose current numeric value to screen readers (aria-valuetext). Ensure focus sequence is logical.
Eve (PM Research): From interviews: people want reassurance that pinning capacity prevents auto downscaling. Could we include a tiny 'pin' affordance on the pool card with tooltip: 'Prevents autoscale from reducing reserved GPUs'?
Sara (Designer): Good idea. I'll add a pin icon with toggle state and microcopy. For the throughput line, wording options: 
A) 'Estimated throughput (approx) 10-250 req/s'
B) 'Estimated requests/sec (range) 1000'
C) 'Projected QPS (approx) 10-200, varies with SLO & burst'
Jordan (PM): Prefer C) because it reminds users about SLO & burst interaction. Keep 'approx'. Also prefer 'requests/sec' wording for clarity in docs.
Mike (SRE): Note: bursting may be unavailable if other customers occupy spare GPUs. Add small inline status: 'burst availability: best-effort'. Also, bursting should visually decrement a customer's burst quota when enabled.
Leah (A11y): Contrast check: current mock uses teal on light green for burst badge 1:1. Fails contrast. Need 4.5:1. Also ensure the tooltip trigger is reachable via keyboard (focusable element).
Sara (Designer): I'll switch to dark teal and add focus outline. For the SLO slider label, propose aria-label: 'Target p95 latency (ms) slider' and aria-valuemin/valuemax set to 50/2000. Good?
Leah (A11y): Yes, and aria-valuetext should say 'p95: XXX ms'. Also ensure instructions for screen reader users: a hidden hint 'Use arrow keys to adjust by 10ms, shift+arrow for 100ms'.
Jordan (PM): About min/max inputs: should we allow decimal GPU counts? No. Only integers. Add validation error copy: 'Min must be <= Max and in whole GPUs.'
Eve (PM Research): Add microcopy under pin CTA: 'Pin capacity prevents automated downscale for this pool.' Keep it short. Users preferred simple verbs.
Mike (SRE): For enterprise tenants: add an inline link to quota docs and a tooltip explaining that pin consumes reserved quota.
design-bot: Checklist update: add pin toggle, burst badge labeled 'best-effort', throughput range instead of point estimate, slider aria, contrast fix. Figma updated: https://figma.com/file/compact-pool/v4
Sara (Designer): I'll push two visual options: compact and spacious. Compact hides the throughput range until expanded. Spacious shows full ranges and tooltips. Which should be default?
Jordan (PM): Default compact for primary flows, but add an 'expand details' affordance. We'll A/B test expand behavior later. Leah 1: please validate keyboard + screenreader on both variants. Mike 1: confirm infra-side burst accounting with ops team and add a note for enterprise.
Leah (A11y): Will run quick checks in 60-90 minutes and post findings here.
Mike (SRE): I'll sync with ops and reply before the crit.
Jordan (PM): Thanks all. Sara, tag me when mocks are updated. I'll bring the compact/spacious decision to crit and note the A/B plan.
